messages:
olivia (Marketing): Draft is in GDrive: product launch blog + practical playbook. I'm aiming for 'how teams cut inference cost' as the hook. link: https://docs.example.com/optimize-launch-draft
devin (Growth): Nice. Two asks: 1) gate a playbook asset for MQL capture, 2) run a subject-line A/B test for the publish email.
kai (Product): i'll paste bench numbers shortly (p50/p95/p99 + recommended config + sample cost calc). will call them "internal bench (typical web dev workload)".
samira (Content): intro currently ~120 words. i'll prune to ~60 and add a boxed quickstart code snippet. also propose a one-paragraph micro-FAQ near the end (common buyer Qs).
olivia (Marketing): agree on the micro-FAQ. can we add an explicit CTA flow: blog -> gated playbook -> webinar? devin, can you own conversion funnel wiring?
devin (Growth): yes. funnel plan: blog utm -> gated playbook (notebook or PDF) capture -> HubSpot workflow sets Lifecycle Stage = marketing qualified -> send 3-day nurture email for webinar invite. tagging: launch_campaign = "optimize_v1"
ben (Sales): sales asks: standard lead tag so SDRs can filter; also need an easy CSV export of playbook downloads for outbound follow-up. can we ensure the webhook captures company domain + job title?
kai (Product): bench numbers added: p50=28ms, p95=96ms, p99=175ms on recommended config; example cost calc included: ~ $0.0019 per 1k tokens with continuous batching. mark as internal.
olivia (Marketing): thanks kai. we'll attribute as "internal benchmark (typical web workload)".
calendar-bot: provisional webinar slot created: 2026-05-21T16:00Z (link: https://cal.example/w/xyz123).
ben (Sales): webinar the week after publish works. sales will co-host two partner seats. request: one-slide "win signals" + suggested follow-up email for SDRs.
samira (Content): structure proposal: 1) one-line problem, 2) playbook steps (routing, caching, quant, batching), 3) bench & cost, 4) quickstart snippet, 5) gated playbook (notebook), 6) micro-FAQ, 7) CTA -> webinar. I'm also drafting a boxed 'if you're in regulated industry' note.
devin (Growth): gating decision: prefer a short interactive notebook instead of static PDF — better engagement. but we still treat downloads as MQL. webhook payload suggestion for devs: 
```
POST /webhooks/hubspot
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "company_domain": "{{company_domain}}",
  "job_title": "{{job_title}}",
  "utm_campaign": "optimize_v1",
  "lead_tag": "optimize_blog",
  "model_profile": "{{model_profile}}",
  "asset_type": "notebook"
}
```
Please confirm required fields.
kai (Product): capturing model_profile + company_domain + job_title = good. will add example model_profile list to the doc.
ben (Sales): confirm we need job_title so SDRs can prioritize; also add a boolean field "is_partner" if they registered via the partner seat link.
olivia (Marketing): good call. adding is_partner to payload and adding partner UTM param: utm_partner=partner_code when applicable.
calendar-bot: reminder set: copy-lock review in #marketing on 2026-04-16T15:00Z.
samira (Content): editorial checklist: tighten intro, add subhead for each playbook step, include code box with minimal sample request, and craft 2 subject lines for the A/B test. drafting now.
devin (Growth): subject line ideas: A) "How top apps cut inference costs — a practical playbook" B) "Reduce inference spend without losing quality — 5 steps". I'll set up A/B in campaign tool.
ben (Sales): request: include a one-paragraph elevator pitch reps can paste into outreach. Also prepare a short 1-slide "battlecard" with objections and rebuttals.
olivia (Marketing): adding sales collateral to /ops/sales-kit; will drop elevator pitch + battlecard there.
kai (Product): small note: please don't publish raw config flags; share recommended presets and link to docs for full config. we don't want people copying experimental flags.
samira (Content): ack. i'll keep config high-level and link to deeper docs.
devin (Growth): timeline check: copy locked Thu, assets (notebook + slides) by Fri, publish Tue. webinar the following week. everyone OK?
ben (Sales): ok from sales.
kai (Product): good from product.
samira (Content): will finalize edits Thu morning and post final in thread.
olivia (Marketing): thank you all. i'll post the copy-locked notice here when it's ready and tag #sales for the kit review.
